research_question: How much higher was BusinessLine's reported magnitude than GDACS's for the Nepal earthquake on 2026-09-08? If unsure, give your best guess. Return only the difference to one decimal place.
verification_query: MATCH (a:NewsArticle {url: 'https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/world/earthquake-in-nepal-53-magnitude-tremor-hits-mustang/article71444371.ece'})-[:RETRIEVED_FOR]->(e:Event {id: 'gdacs-event-1564287-1731979'}) WITH e, a, toFloat(split(split(a.title, ': ')[1], ' ')[0]) AS reported_magnitude, toFloat(split(e.description, ' ')[2]) AS recorded_magnitude RETURN toString(round(reported_magnitude - recorded_magnitude, 1)) AS answer, e.id AS event_id, a.url AS article_url, recorded_magnitude, reported_magnitude, a.title AS article_title, a.description AS article_description

research_question: How many hours after the GDACS start of Nepal's 2026-09-08 earthquake was the BusinessLine report published? Use UTC; round to the nearest whole hour. If unsure, give your best guess. Return only the integer.

research_question: From the tremor count in People's Review's 2026-09-09 Lomanthang report, subtract the number of GDACS earthquake records starting in Nepal on 2026-09-08 or 2026-09-09 (UTC). If unsure, give your best guess. Return only the integer difference.
